fathersHeart.title: Operating in Divine Secrets
paragraphs: Deuteronomy 29:29
29 "The secret things belong to the Lord our God, but those things which are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law. KJV

God is the Owner and Revealer of all secrets. Secrets rule life and men who have ruled in life have the secrets. When there is a secret you don’t know, there will be problems that you cannot solve and an advantage you cannot have.

Don’t joke or despise the manifestation of the Holy Ghost in your life. Don’t ever find yourself in the midst of foolish people who don’t have a divine perspective of life, but a natural perspective. The Holy Ghost wants to show you things before they happen. He is the revealer of the deep things of God.

There are secret things of the devil which he wants to hide from you. These include the plans, operations, strategies and schemes of the devil. The devil’s strength lies in secrecy. Once he can hide his operations from you, he can defeat you. But praise be to God Who always gives His children revelations of the devil’s secrets (2 Kin. 6:8–12). God wants you to live the Christian life by revelation and not just information. How was Elisha in the passage above getting the secrets of the enemy and revealing it to the king of Israel? It wasn’t natural. The medium was supernatural-divine! That is your advantage as a child of God if you will only tap into it. It is my prayer that God will open your eyes and you will see beyond the natural. 2 Kings 6:16-17. You will see the invisible. Hebrews 11:27.

Finally, you must understand that there are things that God has concealed or hidden for you to be found, which include the hidden riches, the hidden wisdom, the hidden paths and the hidden treasures. In order to access these secrets, your eyes, ears, mind, understanding and your heart must be opened to perceive them. The Lord will open your eyes and you will see them.
fathersHeart.quote: The Holy Ghost wants to show you things before they happen. He is the revealer of the deep things of God.
fathersHeart.closing: Till next edition, go and win with Jesus.

blocks.p: The Bible says, “First the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear” (Mark 4:28). There are different seasons: while some people are dealing with the blade of faith or the ear, some have come into the place of the full corn of faith.

It is not every minister who knows how to live by faith and that is why believers should never be confused by whatever happens to another person, even when the person is a minister. Everyone who comes to God must decide to live by faith. It is not every child of God who knows how to live by faith. Believers who have not learnt how to live by faith will bear the consequences because attacks of hell come to everybody. It is important that living by faith becomes a second nature to believers.

The understanding of God is key to living a life of faith. Fear is based on the understanding of the devil, but faith is based on the understanding of God. The two sides of God that believers need to understand are His foreknowledge and His preordination. Foreknowledge simply means He looks at the end from the beginning and without interfering, He knows how everything will turn out.

However, you must be confident in the fact that God has a plan for the areas of problems He has seen. You must feed your mind with the word of God, not just cultural opinions. The battles believers fight are not only determined by external enemies; they are also determined

by how the enemy has fed their minds with information. A lot of times, that information comes from people’s professions. A doctor, for instance, may find it difficult to pray for the dead to rise because of the training he has received over the years. Therefore, the battle each person will fight to walk by faith is different. Practising living by faith will help the believer roll away negative experiences and replace them with divine experiences of God: His reality, faithfulness, power, ability, capacity and limitlessness.

The strength of a believer’s faith can change; God doesn’t change, but faith changes. Every believer has a measure of faith, but it does not remain the same as the believer grows. A minister of the gospel who has been praying for the sick and has seen all kinds of miracles

will not have the struggles of a minister doing that for the first time. A minister who didn’t get any results the first time must still be willing to do it again. Believers must allow themselves to grow and not come under any condemnation when things don’t work at first. Growth helps the believer deal with the issue of evidence.

Just like when a strong internet connection makes downloading fast, a strong faith makes things happen on time but even when what is being downloaded keeps buffering due to poor network, it will eventually be downloaded.

blocks.scripture: Hebrews 11:1–3 1 Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen. 2 For by it the elders obtained a good report. 3 Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

Romans 1:20 For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

blocks.p: Faith is connected to the eternal system of God. The Bible reveals that the physical things are reflections of the invisible things of God. You must not allow your culture to govern your understanding of God. When the centurion in Mat. 8:8 came to Jesus, he said, “...Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.”

And he gave the reason why he spoke so authoritatively, “For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it” (Mat. 8:9). And the Lord said, “...I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel” (Mat. 8:10) Not even among disciples who were following him. The man could connect the spiritual ministry of Jesus to something physical in his own life. In the framework of the mind of the centurion, the possibility of saying no did not exist.
Once the connection of faith is made, it’s only a matter of time for the problems to shift.

One man of God always says, “You don’t have a problem; all you need is more faith.” He understands that no problem exists when there is power to solve the problem. Everyone who has a measure of power does not get threatened by certain problems, and faith connects the believer to the almighty power of God. A believer’s advantage is that his faith connects him to a power that handles every problem. It is thus pivotal for believers to start working on
their faith and stop worrying about their problems.

blocks.scripture: Romans 5:2  by whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

blocks.p: Faith gives the believer access to any kind of experience in God. Faith gives access to provision, but God determines how the provision comes. Worrying about how God will get the miracle done is not in your purview; all you need is to have faith in God and grow in that faith.

blocks.h: The Fight Between Faith and Feelings

blocks.p: In the fight of faith, the believer is not fighting the devil but feelings and thoughts. Once he can stop responding to negative feelings and thoughts, he will control what the devil does. The devil comes through feelings, thoughts, and imaginations, but the believer must

never act on them. In dealing with darkness, believers must know there are: the person of darkness, the power of darkness and the presence of darkness. Jesus has defeated the person of darkness (the devil), but he is still free to roam on this planet until the lease he stole from Adam runs out. As the Church, we have been delivered from the power of darkness, but we have not been delivered from the presence of darkness.

blocks.callout: Once the connection of faith is made, it’s only a matter of time for the problems to shift!

items: I am blessed and none can reverse it!
When the balance of life is weighed, the blessing will tilt it in my favour!
I will be a man wondered at!
My results will not be subject to human laws any more.
My outcomes in life will not be the product of my efforts alone.
No man or devil will find an equation to curse me; it will not work because no one can curse what God has blessed!
If it concerns me, it will work out well!
When it comes to my turn, the music of mercy will play!
I speak over my life: "swiftness, smoothness, sweetness and restfulness"!!
The LORD God of heaven gives me rest!
I prosper! I conquer! I do well!
Life will be sweet for me!
It will only get better for me!

paragraphs: Good evening Mummy,
Up Holy Ghost!
JESUS IS REAL!
GOD IS FAITHFUL!
Mummy, thank you so much to You and Daddy for the privilege to serve in church, especially among the teenagers.
I have a testimony. I was called to resume as a full-time Lecturer at a private university yesterday with a monthly salary of over #300k and other packages.
What surprised me is that during the interview, I was the only applicant in my faculty who didn't graduate from the university. I already concluded they wouldn't pick me.

In the first phase, the panel changed the topic I prepared and asked me to teach a different one on the spot. I was destabilised and didn't do very well, so I thought I wouldn't make it to the next phase, but they still called me.
In the next phase, I found favour before the VC and his Deputy - they were even helping me answer some questions.

Then they asked if I could help make their students godly if given the job, and how I would do it. I started sharing little tips I learned from serving in the Teenagers Church. Immediately they asked me where I worship and where I serve in church. When I said Dream Centre, Teenagers Church, they all responded excitedly that I am the person they need.
Mummy, I can boldly say I got this job because of my assignment in church. What I do in church was exactly what they were looking for and not only academic qualifications.
Thank you always Daddy
Thank you always Mummy.
THANK YOU JESUS!!!

word.title: The Month of Hidden Things and Secret Things
word.subtitle: Respect the unit system of life

blocks.lead: This is the month of secret things and hidden things. The month of the battle of secret things: the secret battles in your lives will be exposed. Hidden things in the lives of individuals will be exposed.

blocks.p: Divine secrets will come to the assistance of those that dwell in the secret place of the most High.
Hidden help and helpers will arise for the saints who have been under the assaults of hidden enemies. Your hidden enemies will be defeated by your hidden divine helpers.

Maintain your hidden kingdom practices. Strengthen them more than ever before this month. Secret instructions will come from the anointing. Maintain the kingdom practices that give control to the Holy Spirit in your closet.
Remember your Father is the one who sees in secret and rewards openly.

Those that have left the secret place will be exposed to assaults of hidden enemies in the open. Go back to those secret practices of fasting, prayers, confession of the word, seeds sowing, savings, etc.

blocks.callout: The secret life will determine the public life from this month.

blocks.p: Be weightier in the closet and you will be dominant in the public! Get rid of every hidden works of darkness so you will not partake of the inheritance of sinners in darkness.

Remember Ananias and Sapphira were judged openly for a long time life of deceit in secret. Remember Elisha, Timothy, Joshua and others were rewarded openly for secret lives of longtime obedience and service in secret places. Mordecai triumphed by the battles of secret things: his hidden labours, Esther in hiding, the secret fasting of Esther, the obedience of Esther to the counsel of Hegai, the secret intercessions of the Jews all played a part in the defeat of Haman's secret plots to wipe them out.

blocks.callout: All the secret plots of the enemies of the church will be thwarted by the secret weapons of God settled before the foundation of the world through the instrumentality of hidden men faithfully praying in secret and carrying out hidden obedience to God.

blocks.p: Destroy any secret store of negative or sinful hidden things and all hidden disobediences to divine instructions in your life or home or affairs this month or else they will be what will bring defeats to you in the battles of hidden things ongoing this month. It is the month of the victory of hidden things.

blocks.callout: Position yourself to take advantage of divine hidden things this month by opening your account of positive hidden and secret things such as personal prayer retreats, personal acts of kindness, secret Bible studies, night intercessions etc. Restore neglected instructions. Strengthen the ongoing secret practices of the divine in your life currently.

blocks.p: Beloved I welcome you to this peculiar month of the secret things. It is a month of secret divine impregnation of spirits with visions of God for today and for tomorrow. Get into your secret place with God to receive your own.
You will not be a victim of satanic hidden activities.

blocks.callout: You will be a beneficiary of the divine hidden things this month in Jesus name!
